params.note: All prices, the horizon, the confidence map and the label thresholds are provisional defaults. The user owns and sets them; confidence is uncalibrated until enough proven findings exist.

labels.later: fix cost * later_ratio <= value < fix cost

params.cost_note: Effort has two parts, kept separate: model dollars and wall-clock minutes. The S/M/L fix_cost_usd bin stays the comparison for the fix label. fix_model_usd and fix_wall_minutes are rough per-bug estimates (provisional), shown beside it.

work_items.model-eval: Run the model-eval step against answer keys

params.delay_note: Provisional. delay_usd = (fix_wall_minutes / 60) x number of work items the bug blocks x delay_usd_per_item_hour. Cost of delay per Reinertsen; this is a linear, flat-rate simplification. Queue order: blocking bugs first, then by value + delay_usd.

eligible_note: eligible = the bug still existed at the commit the run reviewed. F1, F2 and F5 were fixed before 3be0371.

find_cost.source: Cost table in the GitHub run log; job wall time from the Set up job and Complete job timestamps.

bugs.reach_why: Any PR with one reviewable file uploads a slice and crashes.
bugs.impact_why: Exit 2 before the session starts; no review.
bugs.confidence_why: Reproduced in CI run 44610964708 and offline.
bugs.blocks_why: Crashed every run, so nothing downstream could start.

bugs.reach_why: Only runs longer than about 9.5 minutes hit the token refresh; run 3 took 2 minutes.
bugs.impact_why: stopSession fails with the same 401, so the session keeps spending.
bugs.confidence_why: CI run 44611146379 died with 401 and left the session running.
bugs.fix_why: Refresh loop for the OIDC token plus workflow change.
bugs.blocks_why: Any run past 9.5 minutes died; at the time it blocked all real runs.

bugs.reach_why: Needs any other label added while a hunt is running.
bugs.impact_why: The run is cancelled and its replacement skips; no review.
bugs.confidence_why: Traced from GitHub concurrency docs; not reproduced.
bugs.fix_why: Move concurrency to the job or key it on the label.
bugs.blocks_why: A known review-loss path in the workflow is a merge blocker.

bugs.reach_why: Any cancellation or timeout, including every F3 cancel.
bugs.impact_why: Signal handlers never run, so the session keeps spending up to the cap.
bugs.confidence_why: Reproduced locally with bash -e parent and node child.
bugs.fix_why: Use exec node in the step.
bugs.blocks_why: The README's 'nothing keeps spending' claim was false until fixed.

bugs.reach_why: Only the timeout or failure paths that call stopSession mid-run.
bugs.impact_why: Archive is rejected and the runs keep spending.
bugs.confidence_why: Traced from Managed Agents docs; not reproduced.

bugs.reach_why: Needs a finding body that quotes a ``` fence; plausible in a markdown tool repo.
bugs.impact_why: JSON.parse throws after a paid run; exit 2, no review.
bugs.fix_why: Take the last json fence, or parse from the last fence opener to the final fence.
bugs.blocks_why: PR #128 is markdown-heavy, so a finding may quote a fence and the paid review would be lost (guess).

bugs.reach_why: Needs one file whose diff is too large for GitHub to include a patch (seen in this repo's PR #87).
bugs.impact_why: The biggest change goes unread while the review says no confirmed bugs.
bugs.confidence_why: Ran planSlices on a file entry without a patch.
bugs.fix_why: Fetch the file diff another way, or name the unread files in the review.
bugs.blocks_why: No queued PR is known to have a patch-less file.

bugs.reach_why: Needs a non-retryable error or a refusal.
bugs.impact_why: The review is lost either way; the harm is a 50-minute wait and a 'timed out' message instead of exit 2.
bugs.confidence_why: Traced from the workflow-runs docs; not reproduced.
bugs.fix_why: Treat retries_exhausted and refusal as terminal.

bugs.reach_why: Needs the final report request to be what crosses 75% of the budget.
bugs.impact_why: An unwatched extra turn runs on a finished session, bounded by the cap.
bugs.confidence_why: Traced in the poll loop; not reproduced.
bugs.fix_why: Check for done before sending the wrap-up.

bugs.reach_why: Needs two or more parallel provers to choose to run npm ci at overlapping times; the prompt says only where cheap.
bugs.impact_why: Install or test failures unrelated to the claim make provers reject real bugs.
bugs.confidence_why: Traced from the docs on shared thread sandboxes; not reproduced.
bugs.fix_why: Install once before Prove, and give each prover its own scratch directory.
bugs.blocks_why: Provers may reject real bugs, which corrupts the recall the eval measures.

bugs.reach_why: Needs GitHub's OIDC endpoint to fail.
bugs.impact_why: The job still fails one step later; only the failure point is wrong.
bugs.fix_why: Add set -o pipefail or shell: bash.

bugs.reach_why: Needs another workflow in this repo with id-token: write to be abused; none exists today.
bugs.impact_why: Any repo workflow on any event can get a workspace:developer token.
bugs.confidence_why: Follows directly from the documented sub claim formats.
bugs.fix_why: End the subject prefix in :pull_request and fix the docs.
bugs.blocks_why: The README states a false security property; merging would publish it.

bugs.reach_why: Needs the label added to a draft PR.
bugs.impact_why: The check skips silently; the user can mark the PR ready instead.

bugs.reach_why: Any exit other than a posted review; 2 of the first 3 real runs failed.
bugs.impact_why: Nearest class: leftover diff files in storage, no change to the result.
bugs.confidence_why: Read from the single delete call site.
